title: GoHighLevel Landing Page Designer & Funnel Builder Needed | Calendar Integration

facts: Original post preserved in jd.txt. No business, industry, offer, staff, calendar provider or meeting duration is stated.
GoHighLevel native calendar chosen for the requested calendar integration. Sam, Jamie, online meeting, 30-minute duration and America/Chicago timezone are illustrative only.
No invented client logo, claim, testimonial, conversion percentage, commercial result or past GHL funnel link.
Page CTA → Neo Calendar element → next funnel step is based on official GHL documentation in preparation.md. Current exact widget/form references remain qualified; no production parity claim.
Architecture is custom overview, not a GHL Funnel Builder. Public pages are sample customer-facing page content, not an admin screen.
